1.english_reference: A Prayer of Moses the man of God .

traditions.WLC: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְ מֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ הָ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים
traditions.LXX: Προσευχὴ τοῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Orátio Móysi hóminis Dei .
traditions.KJV: A Prayer of Moses the man of God .

1.english_reference: Lord , thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations .

traditions.WLC: אֲֽדֹנָ֗ י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗ נוּ בְּ דֹ֣ר וָ דֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , καταφυγὴ ἡμῖν ἐγενήθης ἐν γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ ·
traditions.VUL: Dómine , refúgium factus es nobis , a generatióne in generatiónem .
traditions.KJV: Lord , thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations .

2.english_reference: Before the mountains were brought forth

traditions.WLC: בְּ טֶ֤רֶם הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ
traditions.LXX: πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη γενηθῆναι
traditions.VUL: Priúsquam montes fíerent ,
traditions.KJV: Before the mountains were brought forth ,

2.english_reference: or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְ תֵבֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ πλασθῆναι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην ,
traditions.VUL: aut formarétur terra et orbis :
traditions.KJV: or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world ,

2.english_reference: even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God

traditions.WLC: וּֽ מֵ עוֹלָ֥ם עַד ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ .
traditions.VUL: a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum tu es Deus .
traditions.KJV: even from everlasting to everlasting , thou [ art ] God .

traditions.WLC: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּ֑א
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἄνθρωπον εἰς ταπείνωσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Ne avértas hóminem in humilitátem :
traditions.KJV: Thou turnest man to destruction ;

3.english_reference: and sayest, Return, ye children of men

traditions.WLC: וַ֝ תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπας Ἐπιστρέψατε υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων ?
traditions.VUL: et dixísti : Convertímini fílii hóminum .
traditions.KJV: and sayest , Return , ye children of men .

4.english_reference: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽ עֵינֶ֗י ךָ כְּ י֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι χίλια ἔτη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἐχθὲς ἥτις διῆλθεν ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam mille anni ante óculos tuos , tamquam dies hestérna quæ prætériit :
traditions.KJV: For a thousand years in thy sight [ are but ] as yesterday when it is past ,

4.english_reference: and as a watch in the night

traditions.WLC: וְ אַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַ לָּֽיְלָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ φυλακὴ ἐν νυκτί .
traditions.VUL: et custódia in nocte ,
traditions.KJV: and [ as ] a watch in the night .

5.english_reference: Thou carriest them away as with a flood

traditions.WLC: זְ֭רַמְתָּ ם
traditions.LXX: τὰ ἐξουδενώματα αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: quæ pro níhilo habéntur ,
traditions.KJV: Thou carriest them away as with a flood ;

traditions.WLC: שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ
traditions.LXX: ἔτη ἔσονται ,
traditions.VUL: eórum anni erunt .
traditions.KJV: they are [ as ] a sleep :

5.english_reference: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up

traditions.WLC: בַּ֝ בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּ חָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף
traditions.LXX: τὸ πρωὶ ὡσεὶ χλόη παρέλθοι ·
traditions.KJV: in the morning [ they are ] like grass [ which ] groweth up .

6.english_reference: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up

traditions.WLC: בַּ֭ בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְ חָלָ֑ף
traditions.LXX: τὸ πρωὶ ἀνθήσαι καὶ παρέλθοι ,
traditions.VUL: Mane sicut herba tránseat , mane flóreat , et tránseat :
traditions.KJV: In the morning it flourisheth , and groweth up ;

6.english_reference: in the evening it is cut down, and withereth

traditions.WLC: לָ֝ עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְ יָבֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποπέσοι , σκληρυνθείη καὶ ξηρανθείη .
traditions.VUL: véspere décidat , indúret , et aréscat .
traditions.KJV: in the evening it is cut down , and withereth .

7.english_reference: For we are consumed by thine anger

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי כָלִ֥ינוּ בְ אַפֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐξελίπομεν ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Quia defécimus in ira tua ,
traditions.KJV: For we are consumed by thine anger ,

7.english_reference: and by thy wrath are we troubled

traditions.WLC: וּֽ בַ חֲמָתְ ךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐταράχθημεν ·
traditions.VUL: et in furóre tuo turbáti sumus .
traditions.KJV: and by thy wrath are we troubled .

8.english_reference: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee

traditions.WLC: שת עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣י נוּ לְ נֶגְדֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἔθου τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν ἐνώπιόν σου ,
traditions.VUL: Posuísti iniquitátes nostras in conspéctu tuo :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee ,

8.english_reference: our secret sins in the light of thy countenance

traditions.WLC: עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗ נוּ לִ מְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὁ αἰὼν ἡμῶν εἰς φωτισμὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου .
traditions.VUL: sǽculum nostrum in illuminatióne vultus tui .
traditions.KJV: our secret [ sins ] in the light of thy countenance .

9.english_reference: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כָל יָ֭מֵי נוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְ עֶבְרָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον , καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ἐξελίπομεν ·
traditions.VUL: Quóniam omnes dies nostri defecérunt : et in ira tua defécimus .
traditions.KJV: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath :

9.english_reference: we spend our years as a tale that is told

traditions.WLC: כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣י נוּ כְמוֹ הֶֽגֶה
traditions.LXX: τὰ ἔτη ἡμῶν ὡς ἀράχνην ἐμελέτων .
traditions.VUL: Anni nostri sicut aránea meditabúntur :
traditions.KJV: we spend our years as a tale [ that is told ] .

10.english_reference: The days of our years are threescore years and ten

traditions.WLC: יְמֵֽי שְׁנוֹתֵ֨י נוּ בָ הֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה
traditions.LXX: αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν ἡμῶν ἐν ἐνιαυτοῖς ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ,
traditions.VUL: dies annórum nostrórum in ipsis , septuagínta anni .
traditions.KJV: The days of our years [ are ] threescore years and ten ;

10.english_reference: and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֤ם בִּ גְבוּרֹ֨ת שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν δυναστείαις , ὀγδοήκοντα ἔτη ,
traditions.VUL: Si autem in potentátibus octogínta anni :
traditions.KJV: and if by reason of strength [ they be ] fourscore years ,

10.english_reference: yet is their strength labour and sorrow

traditions.WLC: וְ֭ רָהְבָּ ם עָמָ֣ל וָ אָ֑וֶן
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ πλεῖον αὐτῶν κόπος καὶ πόνος ·
traditions.VUL: et ámplius eórum , labor et dolor .
traditions.KJV: yet [ is ] their strength labour and sorrow ;

10.english_reference: for it is soon cut off, and we fly away

traditions.WLC: כִּי גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַ נָּעֻֽפָ ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπῆλθεν πραύτης ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς , καὶ παιδευθησόμεθα .
traditions.VUL: Quóniam supervénit mansuetúdo : et corripiémur .
traditions.KJV: for it is soon cut off , and we fly away .

11.english_reference: Who knoweth the power of thine anger ?

traditions.WLC: מִֽי י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: τίς γινώσκει τὸ κράτος τῆς ὀργῆς σου ,
traditions.VUL: Quis novit potestátem iræ tuæ :
traditions.KJV: Who knoweth the power of thine anger ?

11.english_reference: even according to thy fear , [ so is ] thy wrath .

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ כְ יִרְאָתְ ךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου τοῦ θυμοῦ σου ἐξαριθμήσασθαι ?
traditions.VUL: et præ timóre tuo iram tuam
traditions.KJV: even according to thy fear , [ so is ] thy wrath .

12.english_reference: So teach [ us ] to number our days ,

traditions.WLC: לִ מְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵי נוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע
traditions.LXX: τὴν δεξιάν σου γνώρισον ,
traditions.VUL: dinumeráre ? Déxteram tuam sic notam fac ,
traditions.KJV: So teach [ us ] to number our days ,

12.english_reference: that we may apply [ our ] hearts unto wisdom .

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς πεπαιδευμένους τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐν σοφίᾳ .
traditions.VUL: et erudítos corde in sapiéntia .
traditions.KJV: that we may apply [ our ] hearts unto wisdom .

traditions.WLC: שׁוּבָ֣ ה יְ֭הוָה עַד מָתָ֑י
traditions.LXX: ἐπίστρεψον , Κύριε · ἕως πότε ?
traditions.VUL: Convértere Dómine úsquequo ?
traditions.KJV: Return , O LORD , how long ?

13.english_reference: and let it repent thee concerning thy servants .

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל עֲבָדֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρακλήθητι ἐπὶ τοῖς δούλοις σου .
traditions.VUL: et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos .
traditions.KJV: and let it repent thee concerning thy servants .

14.english_reference: O satisfy us early with thy mercy ;

traditions.WLC: שַׂבְּעֵ֣ נוּ בַ בֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐνεπλήσθημεν τὸ πρωὶ τοῦ ἐλέους σου ,
traditions.VUL: Repléti sumus mane misericórdia tua :
traditions.KJV: O satisfy us early with thy mercy ;

14.english_reference: that we may rejoice and be glad all our days .

traditions.WLC: וּֽ נְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝ נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּ כָל יָמֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠγαλλιασάμεθα καὶ εὐφράνθημεν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et exsultávimus , et delectáti sumus ómnibus diébus nostris .
traditions.KJV: that we may rejoice and be glad all our days .

15.english_reference: Make us glad according to the days [ wherein ] thou hast afflicted us ,

traditions.WLC: שַׂ֭מְּחֵ נוּ כִּ ימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑ נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἡμερῶν ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: Lætáti sumus pro diébus , quibus nos humiliásti :
traditions.KJV: Make us glad according to the days [ wherein ] thou hast afflicted us , [ and ]

15.english_reference: [and] the years [ wherein ] we have seen evil .

traditions.WLC: שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐτῶν ὧν εἴδομεν κακά .
traditions.VUL: annis quibus vídimus mala .
traditions.KJV: the years [ wherein ] we have seen evil .

16.english_reference: Let thy work appear unto thy servants ,

traditions.WLC: יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֣י ךָ פָעֳלֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἴδε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου ,
traditions.VUL: Réspice in servos tuos , et in ópera tua :
traditions.KJV: Let thy work appear unto thy servants ,

16.english_reference: and thy glory unto their children .

traditions.WLC: וַ֝ הֲדָרְ ךָ֗ עַל בְּנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁδήγησον τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et dírige fílios eórum .
traditions.KJV: and thy glory unto their children .

17.english_reference: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us :

traditions.WLC: וִ יהִ֤י נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥ י אֱלֹהֵ֗י נוּ עָ֫לֵ֥י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: Et sit splendor Dómini Dei nostri super nos ,
traditions.KJV: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us :

17.english_reference: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵי נוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ ה עָלֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς .
traditions.VUL: et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos :
traditions.KJV: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us ;

17.english_reference: yea , the work of our hands establish thou it .

traditions.WLC: וּֽ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗י נוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽ הוּ
traditions.VUL: et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige .
traditions.KJV: yea , the work of our hands establish thou it .
